CodeMirror 5.65.1 (Marijn Haverbeke and others), lib/codemirror.js and lib/codemirror.css, minified; and, in
addons.min.js / addons.css, the addons edit/matchbrackets, edit/closebrackets, fold/foldcode, fold/foldgutter,
search/searchcursor, dialog/dialog and the keymaps emacs and vim, from the same release, minified.

sections and environments, and the code check are written for Scriptavera in editor*.js.
